name: OxZygen
author: 3dthc
summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, sung doos, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, delay, reverb and sub. 96 presets; a CRT crystal-ball orb reacts as you play. Gen1 (MPC OS 3.x, plus an OS 2.x zip) and Gen2.
